jobs.title: Senior C#/.NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Utveckla mjukvara för fordonskommunikation och fjärrfunktioner i ett erfaret agilt team i Göteborg. Vill du utveckla lösningar som kopplar samman fordon, verktyg och fjärrfunktioner genom hela produktlivscykeln? Här får du en senior roll i ett agilt team som bygger robusta och återanvändbara mjukvarulösningar för fordonsnära kommunikation. Om rollen Arbeta med kommunikationsgränssnitt mellan fordon, verktyg och fjärrfunktioner.
  
  
Bidra till produkter som används inom utveckling, test, produktion, verkstad och fjärrscenarier. Ta en senior teknisk roll i ett självorganiserande Scrum-team. Det här kommer du göra Designa, implementera och testa mjukvarulösningar i C# och .NET Core. Driva leveranser från lösningsdesign till support och acceptanstest.
  
  
Samarbeta nära intressenter för att skapa gemensamma och återanvändbara lösningar. Utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar för mobil och plattformsoberoende användning. Bidra till kvalitet, automatisering och kontinuerlig förbättring i teamets leverans. Vi söker dig som har Gedigen och senior erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling i C# och .NET Core.
  
  
Erfarenhet av mobilutveckling med MAUI, Xamarin, iOS eller Android. Kunskap om DevOps och flertrådad programmering. Vana att arbeta enligt Scrum och andra agila arbetssätt. Meriterande erfarenhet av diagnostiska kommunikationsprotokoll och molnintegration.
  
  
Teknik & Verktyg C# och .NET Core MAUI, Xamarin, iOS och Android Visual Studio och Git DevOps och flertrådad programmering ISO 14229, SAE J1587, Azure och AWS Praktisk information Ort: Göteborg Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat Språk: Engelska

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

This is an exciting opportunity to join JPMorgan, this role is a **Jobshare** (part-time hours where 2 people share the responsibility of the role) if this is the flexibility you need this could be the role for you.

**This is Jobshare/ Part-time role - Schedule required is - 18hrs - Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday & Friday either working AM/PM there is flexibility on these days & hours**

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within CIB, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way.

You are responsible for delivering critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions, in support of the firm's business objectives.

**Job responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems
* Creates secure, high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met through software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies
* Contributes to a team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect
* Formal training/certification in Software Engineering (or equivalent experience) with 3+ years of applied, hands-on development experience.
* Hands-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and production support, with a focus on operational stability (monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis).
* Proficiency in one or more modern object-oriented, compiled languages (e.g., Java, C#, C++, Go, Rust) and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well-structured code.
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment using one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies and practices such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* AI-enabled productivity: Demonstrated ability to use AI/LLM tools responsibly to improve day-to-day engineering work while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and usage guidelines.
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Formal training/certification in Software Engineering (or equivalent experience) with 3+ years of applied, hands-on development experience.
* Hands-on experience across system design, application development, automated testing, and production support, with a focus on operational stability (monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis).
* Proficiency in one or more modern object-oriented, compiled languages (e.g., Java, C#, C++, Go, Rust) and the ability to write clean, maintainable, well-structured code.
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment using one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies and practices such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* Demonstrated knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)
* AI-enabled productivity: Demonstrated ability to use AI/LLM tools responsibly to improve day-to-day engineering work while adhering to applicable data privacy, security, and usage guidelines.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Familiarity with modern front-end technologies
* Familiarity with Java Spring Boot services.
* Exposure to cloud technologies

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description:
The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love us—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

**Role overview**

The International team is seeking a talented and driven Software Engineer II to join the first engineering team in Ireland and work on exciting product initiatives for our Canadian and UK markets.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the full software development lifecycle – across both the frontend and backend – collaborating with Engineering and Product peers to design innovative solutions and tackle complex challenges for our dealer-facing products.

We are looking for candidates who are able to learn and adapt quickly, and collaborate with other engineers to deliver solutions.

**Some examples of potential project opportunities:**

  

* Building new, full-stack features for dealer products from the ground up Integrating with existing services and expanding functionality using React, TypeScript, and Java
* Implementing integrations with third-party APIs and partners As an engineer on this team, you will work closely with other engineers and product partners to deliver impactful solutions for the international business.
* No need to be a car expert—we’re more interested in your passion for engineering and your ability to innovate!

**What you'll do**

  

* Help establish and grow Dublin engineering presence by contributing to team culture, practices, and standards.
* Collaborate with engineers and product managers across the organization to understand and solve new product requirements and tackle technical challenges.
* Work with Java, Spring Boot, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, AWS, and other modern technologies to build consumer and dealer products.
* Collaborate on system design and write well-crafted code to help evolve our service-oriented architecture.
* Be deeply engaged in the full development lifecycle: designing, developing, testing, automated testing, deploying, maintaining, monitoring, and alerting.

**What you'll bring**

  

* 2-5 years of hands-on software development experience in a professional setting.
* Experience building full-stack applications with frameworks similar to Spring Boot, NextJS, Express, ASP.NET, Django, or Rails.
* Ability to write clean, well-tested, and efficient code that passes through code review with minimal comments
* . Additionally, you will engage with code reviews by giving and receiving feedback to ensure high-quality outcomes.
* The ability to iterate and ship ideas quickly and independently. Self-led and motivated to proactively find answers and resolve blockers.
* Experience leveraging AI tools.
* Bonus: Experience using AWS services and knowledge of microservice architectures.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Oracle PL/SQL)
jobs.description:
**Contract Role | Dublin (Hybrid) | Negotiable Daily Rate**

  

We are partnering with a leading **Tier 1 global investment bank** to hire an experienced **Software Engineer** for a long-term contract opportunity within a critical Finance Technology team.

This role sits within the bank's **Enterprise Finance Technology division** , supporting a flagship finance and sub-ledger platform responsible for processing millions of daily transactions across debt, credit derivatives, and cash products. You'll join a highly collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing platform capabilities, driving operational excellence, and delivering strategic technology solutions that support global finance operations.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong Oracle PL/SQL developer with an interest in large-scale financial systems, data processing, and enterprise architecture within a complex banking environment.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing key components of a strategic sub-ledger platform that underpins financial reporting and accounting processes. Working closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and global development teams, you will deliver scalable solutions that support both business growth and regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and implement enhancements to existing platform functionality.
* Contribute to architectural improvements and modernisation initiatives.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production and application issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional Finance Technology teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Work closely with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define, develop, and sign off user stories.
* Participate in application design, code reviews, and best practice initiatives.
* Support regression test automation and continuous improvement efforts.
* Actively contribute to Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives, and reviews.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across multiple teams and global locations.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

### **Essential**

* Strong commercial experience with **Oracle Database (10g, 11g, 12c, or 19c)** .
* Advanced **PL/SQL development** skills, including procedures, functions, and performance optimisation.
* Proven experience in **SQL performance tuning** and query optimisation.
* Strong object-oriented design and software engineering principles.
* Understanding of design patterns and enterprise application architecture.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Experience working within global or distributed development teams.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to take ownership of issues through to resolution.
* Collaborative approach with a willingness to share ideas and contribute to team best practices.

### **Desirable**

* Commercial Python development experience.
* UNIX/Linux environments.
* C#/.NET development experience.
* Experience building desktop or Windows-based applications.
* Git and Bitbucket version control.
* Quartz scheduling framework experience.
* Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Automated testing tools and frameworks.
* SQL Server knowledge.
* Previous investment banking or capital markets experience.
* Understanding of finance, accounting processes, general ledger structures, and financial reporting workflows.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders at different levels.
* Self-starter who takes ownership and drives issues through to completion.
* Team player who thrives in collaborative, fast-paced environments.
* Passion for improving engineering standards and software quality.
* Ability to build effective relationships across business, technology, and support teams.

If you're an experienced Oracle PL/SQL Engineer looking to work on a high-profile finance technology platform within a leading global bank, we'd love to hear from you.
